skill.name: agent-tools
skill.description: Guides agents through inference.sh CLI workflows for discovering and running hosted AI apps, including image, video, LLM, search, audio, 3D, and X automation tools.
skill.summary: Run hosted AI apps through the inference.sh CLI from Claude, Codex, and Claude Code.
skill.author: inference-sh-skills

security_audit.summary: Most hardcoded URL, environment variable, and Markdown backtick detections are documentation for expected inference.sh CLI usage. The remote curl-to-shell installer is a confirmed critical risk, and manual installation plus related skill installation commands add filesystem and remote-content risk. No prompt injection text was found, but local file upload and X automation require explicit user approval.

remediation.suggestion: Replace curl-to-shell instructions with package manager commands or a verified download flow that users can inspect before execution.

remediation.issue: Manual install modifies user PATH with a downloaded binary
remediation.suggestion: Document the exact destination, require checksum verification from an independent source, and avoid unattended writes to user executable paths.

remediation.issue: Local file inputs are uploaded to a cloud service
remediation.suggestion: Add explicit consent guidance before using local paths, and recommend allowlisted project files for agent-driven runs.

remediation.issue: X automation can publish or modify account state
remediation.suggestion: Require a human confirmation step before posting, messaging, liking, following, or reposting through X apps.

semantic_findings.title: Automatic Local File Upload Can Expose User Files
semantic_findings.description: The skill states that local file paths are automatically uploaded when an app input accepts a URL or file. An agent could disclose private images, audio, or media files if it uses local paths without explicit approval.
semantic_findings.confidence_reasoning: Both files explicitly describe automatic local file upload behavior and show local image, audio, and media path examples. This is a clear data disclosure risk unless user consent is enforced.

semantic_findings.title: External Social Actions Can Modify an X Account
semantic_findings.description: The skill includes examples for posting to X and lists actions such as direct messages, follows, likes, and reposts. These actions can publish content or modify account state if run without human confirmation.
semantic_findings.confidence_reasoning: The cited lines directly identify X posting and account actions as supported apps. The risk is contextual because these are legitimate features, but they have external side effects.

content.user_title: Run Cloud AI Apps from Your Agent
content.value_statement: AI agents need a consistent way to discover and run hosted models. This skill guides Claude, Codex, and Claude Code through inference.sh CLI workflows.
actual_capabilities: Shows how to install and authenticate the inference.sh CLI.
Lists commands for discovering, filtering, and inspecting available apps.
Provides examples for running image, video, LLM, search, audio, 3D, and X apps.
Explains local file input handling, task tracking, and result retrieval.
Documents environment variable authentication and shell completion commands.
Links to related inference.sh skills and official documentation.
limitations: Requires the inference.sh CLI and a valid account or API key.
Commands depend on available apps, credits, and network access.
Local file paths can upload files to inference.sh when used as inputs.
It does not validate third-party app behavior or output quality.

use_cases.title: Generate Media Assets
use_cases.description: Use hosted image, video, audio, and 3D apps from a single CLI workflow.

use_cases.title: Run Model Tasks During Development
use_cases.description: Discover app schemas, create sample inputs, submit tasks, and check results from an agent session.

use_cases.title: Automate Research and Publishing Steps
use_cases.description: Use search, LLM, and X automation apps when an approved workflow needs external services.

prompt_templates.title: Find an App
prompt_templates.prompt: Use agent-tools to find inference.sh apps for image generation. Show the best matches and explain what each app does.

prompt_templates.title: Prepare a Run
prompt_templates.prompt: Use agent-tools to inspect the input requirements for a video generation app. Create a safe input plan before running it.

prompt_templates.title: Run and Track a Task
prompt_templates.prompt: Use agent-tools to run an approved inference.sh app, track the task, and summarize the result when it completes.

prompt_templates.title: Compare App Options
prompt_templates.prompt: Use agent-tools to compare image, video, and LLM apps for this workflow. Recommend one option with tradeoffs, costs, and required inputs.

output_examples.input: Ask for an image generation app that can use a text prompt.
output: The agent identifies suitable image apps and explains their strengths.
It describes the required prompt fields and optional quality settings.
It asks before running the app or uploading any local file.

output_examples.input: Ask to run a long video task and check progress later.
output: The agent prepares the video app input and submits the approved task.
It records the task identifier and checks the task status on request.
It summarizes completion status and available result links.

output_examples.input: Ask to use a search app and summarize current information.
output: The agent selects a search app and sends the approved query.
It returns a concise summary with source-oriented context.
It notes limits from the selected app and the returned results.

best_practices: Review app schemas before submitting prompts, files, or account actions.
Use scoped API keys for automation and rotate any exposed credentials.
Require explicit approval before uploading local files or posting to X.
anti_patterns: Do not pipe remote installers to a shell in unattended sessions.
Do not upload private local files without explicit user approval.
Do not run social automation actions without human confirmation.

faq.question: What does this skill help an agent do?
faq.answer: It helps an agent discover and run inference.sh apps through documented CLI workflows.

faq.question: Does it require an inference.sh account?
faq.answer: Yes. Authentication is required for most app runs and for API key based automation.

faq.question: Can it generate images and videos?
faq.answer: Yes. The references include examples for image, video, audio, 3D, search, and LLM apps.

faq.question: Can it upload local files?
faq.answer: Yes. The CLI can upload local file paths when an app input accepts files, so approval is important.

faq.question: Can it post to X?
faq.answer: The skill documents X automation apps. Users should require confirmation before posting, liking, following, or sending messages.

faq.question: Is installation automatic?
faq.answer: No. The skill documents installation commands, but remote installers should be reviewed before execution.
